reviews.author: Ritika Sahu
reviews.text: Ordered the family pack for a Sunday lunch. Reached hot, packing was solid, and the butter chicken was as good as it is in the restaurant.

reviews.author: Amit Trivedi
reviews.text: We do our office lunch order here almost daily. They actually deliver by 1 pm like they say, which no one else manages.

reviews.author: Neha Bansal
reviews.text: Weekend buffet is good value for 449. Chaat counter had a queue but the staff kept the tandoor plates coming to the table.

reviews.author: Faizan Khan
reviews.text: Booked a table for 12 for my father's birthday. They set it up in the corner section and handled the cake without being asked twice.
